entries.target: 所有闪电伤害法术 +1

entries.target: %s使用了%s%s，治愈了%s疾病和毒素！

entries.source: Farian was King Toknor's captain, and fought by his side in the great Battle of Last Hope.  However, when he returned after the battle to find his hometown burnt in an orcish pyre, a madness overtook him.  The desire for vengeance made him quit the army and strike out on his own, lightly armoured and carrying nought but his sword.  Most thought him dead until the reports came back of a fell figure tearing through the orcish encampments, slaughtering all before him and mercilessly butchering the corpses after.  It is said his blade drank the blood of 100 orcs each day until finally all of Maj'Eyal was cleared of their presence.  When the final orc was slain and no more were to be found, Farian at the last turned the blade on himself and stuck it through his chest.  Those nearby said his body shook with convulsions as he did so, though they could not tell whether he was laughing or crying.
entries.target: 法瑞安曾是图库纳国王的指挥官，在最后希望的伟大战役中跟随国王并肩作战。然而，当他在战役结束后归来时，却发现故乡已被兽人付之一炬，他陷入了疯狂。复仇的欲望使他离开军队，孤身一人踏上了征程，他轻装上阵，除了一柄剑之外别无他物。大多数人都以为他已经死了，直到有消息称有一个毁灭者般的身影正在摧残兽人的营地，他屠杀了所有见到的兽人并残忍地肢解对方的尸体。据说他每天要用100个兽人的鲜血来祭刀，直到杀光马基·埃亚尔的兽人。当最后一个兽人被杀死并且没有发现更多的时候，法瑞安最终把利刃转向了自己——那把剑刺穿了他的胸膛。那些在附近的目击者说，当法瑞安这样做的时候身体伴随着阵阵痉挛，他们说不清他到底是哭是笑。

entries.source: The simplest of belts, worn for centuries by Nessilla Tantaelen as she tended to her people and forests. Some of her wisdom and power have settled permanently into its fibers.
entries.target: 最朴素的腰带，被奈希拉·坦泰兰在照料她的人民和森林期间穿戴了几个世纪。这条腰带永久地保存了她的部分智慧和力量。

entries.source: Only supremacy of the arcane can release its full power.
entries.target: 只有奥术至上才能完全发挥它的力量。

entries.source: This dagger was used by a nameless healer during the Age of Dusk. The plagues that ravaged his town were beyond the ability of mortal man to treat, so he took to using his dagger to as an act of mercy when faced with hopeless patients. Despite his good intentions, it is now cursed with dark power, letting it kill in a single stroke against those already weakened.
entries.target: 这柄匕首曾被黄昏纪一名无名的治疗师使用。瘟疫袭击了城镇，而医者终究是凡人，他便用这柄匕首为那些救治无望的病人结束痛苦，以示慈悲。尽管初衷是好的，这柄匕首现在已经被黑暗力量污染，用它伤害虚弱的敌人威力更大。

entries.source: #DARK_GREEN#The armor molds comfortably to one of its caretakers.
entries.target: #DARK_GREEN#这件护甲舒适地贴合在它的一位照料者身上。

entries.source: pulsing infusion
entries.target: 脉动的纹身

entries.source: A small crystal phial that captured Sunlight during the Summertide.
entries.target: 一个在炎华时节捕获了阳光的小水晶瓶。

entries.source:
The first Halfling mages during the Age of Allure discovered how to capture the Sunlight and infuse gems with it.
This star is the culmination of their craft. Light radiates from its ever-shifting yellow surface.
entries.target:
厄流纪最初的半身人法师们发现了如何捕捉日光并将其注入宝石。
这颗星辰是他们工艺的结晶。光芒从其不断变幻的黄色表面放射出来。

entries.source: The boots of a Rogue outcast, who knew that the best way to deal with a problem was to run from it.
entries.target: 这双靴子属于一位被放逐的盗贼，他处理麻烦的方法就是三十六计走为上计。

entries.source: Helm of the Dwarven Emperors
entries.target: 矮人皇帝头盔

entries.source: Spider-Silk Robe of Spydrë
entries.target: 斯派德的蛛丝长袍

entries.source: spider-silk robe
entries.target: 蛛丝长袍

entries.source: This set of robes is made wholly of spider silk. It looks outlandish and some sages think it came from another world, probably through a farportal.
entries.target: 这套长袍完全用蛛丝制成。它看起来充满异国风情，一些智者推测它来自另一个世界，很可能穿越过时空之门。

entries.source: expertly-crafted dwarven-steel gauntlets
entries.target: 精工打造的矮人钢臂铠

entries.source: massive, stained girdle
entries.target: 硕大而肮脏的腰带

entries.source: This girdle is enchanted with mighty wards against expanding girth. Whatever the source of its wondrous strength, it will prove of great aid in the transport of awkward burdens.
entries.target: 这条腰带附有强大的守护魔法，可以抵御腰围的膨胀。无论它神奇的力量源自何处，它都会在搬运笨重的负担时大有助益。

entries.source: Some giant wraps would make you feel great.
entries.target: 要是再有一副巨人护手，你会感觉棒极了。

entries.source:
An ancient set of robes that has survived from the Age of Allure. Primal magic forces inhabit it.
It was made by Humans for Humans; only they can harness the true power of the robes.
entries.target:
这件古老的长袍从厄流纪保存了下来。上古的魔法力量占据着它。
它由人类专门为人类制造；只有他们才能驾驭这件长袍的真正力量。

entries.source: #STEEL_BLUE#A time vortex briefly appears in front of you.
entries.target: #STEEL_BLUE#一个时间漩涡在你面前短暂出现。

entries.source: metal whip
entries.target: 金属鞭

entries.source: Girdle of Preservation
entries.target: 永存腰带

entries.source: #BLUE#The skin seems pleased to be worn by the unliving, and grows silent.
entries.target: #BLUE#这件皮甲似乎很满意被亡灵穿着，沉默了下来。

entries.source: Kroltar's head would turn up the heat.
entries.target: 若再配上库洛塔的龙盔，火势会更旺。

entries.source: This heavy dwarven-steel armour was created in the deepest forges of the Iron Throne. While it grants incomparable protection, it demands that you rely only on your own strength.
entries.target: 这件沉重的矮人钢护甲打造于钢铁王座最深的熔炉。虽然它能提供举世无双的防护，但它要求你只依靠自身的力量。

entries.source: The wise ones say that truth is a three-edged sword. And sometimes, the truth hurts.
entries.target: 智者有云，真理是一把三棱剑。而有时，真理会伤人。

entries.source: Eldritch
entries.target: 奥术

entries.source:
This mighty axe can cleave through armour like the sharpest swords, yet hit with all the impact of a heavy club.
It is said the wielder will slowly grow mad. This, however, has never been proven - no known possessor of this item has lived to tell the tale.
entries.target:
这把强力的斧头能像最锋利的剑一样劈开护甲，却能造成如同钝器一般的重击。
据说持有者会慢慢变得疯狂。不过，这种说法从未得到证实——已知的持有者无一活下来讲述此事。

entries.source: #CRIMSON#The echoes of time resound as the blades are reunited once more.
entries.target: #CRIMSON#双刃再度重聚，时间的回响随之激荡。

entries.source: This strange orange quiver is made of brass and etched with many bright red runes that glow and glitter in the light.  The arrows themselves appear to be solid shafts of blazing hot light, like rays of sunshine, hammered and forged into a solid state.
entries.target: 这个奇特的橙色箭壶由黄铜制成，壶身铭刻着许多亮红色符文，在光线下熠熠闪光。箭矢本身仿佛就是炽热光芒凝成的实体箭杆，如同阳光被锤炼锻造成了固态。

entries.source: blazing shot
entries.target: 炽热的弹药

entries.source: Pristine flowers coat the surface of this mindstar. Touching it fills you with a sense of calm and refreshes your body.
entries.target: 纯净的花朵覆盖着这颗灵晶。触摸它时，你会感到心境平和，身体也焕然一新。

entries.source: humming mindstar
entries.target: 嗡鸣的灵晶

entries.source: strike all targets in a line (for 100%% weapon damage as mind) out to range 4
entries.target: 打击一条直线上范围4以内的所有目标，造成相当于100%%武器伤害的精神伤害。

entries.source: This mass of putrid slime burst from Corpathus, and seems quite hungry.
entries.target: 这团腐臭的黏液从卡帕萨斯中迸出，看起来十分饥饿。

entries.source: The eye on the hilt of this blade seems to glare at you, piercing your soul and mind. Tentacles surround the hilt, latching onto your hand.
entries.target: 这柄剑剑柄上的眼睛似乎在怒视着你，洞穿你的灵魂与心智。触须缠绕着剑柄，攀附在你的手上。

entries.source: Anmalice focuses its mind-piercing eye on #Target#!
entries.target: 扭曲之刃·圣灵之眼将它穿透心智的目光集中在了 #Target# 上！

entries.source: This heavy, ridged blade emanates magical power, yet as you grasp the handle an icy chill runs its course through your spine. You feel the disembodied presence of all those slain by it. In unison, they demand company.
entries.target: 这把沉重的脊刃长剑散发着魔法力量，然而当你握住剑柄时，一阵寒意沿着脊背蔓延开来。你感到所有葬身剑下之人那无形的存在。他们异口同声，索要同伴。

entries.source: deal %0.2f arcane and %0.2f darkness damage (based on Magic) in a radius 1 around the target
entries.target: 对目标造成%0.2f奥术和%0.2f暗影伤害（基于魔力）

entries.source: sleek stringed bow
entries.target: 光滑的上弦弓

entries.source: This whip appears to have been made from a human spine. A handle sits on one end, a sharply honed claw on the other.
entries.target: 这根鞭子看上去像是人类的脊骨做成，一端有一个柄，另一端是一只磨得锋利的爪子。

entries.source: Attack speed improves with your strength and size category.
entries.target: 攻击速度随力量和体型的提升而加快。

entries.source: #ORCHID#Umbraphage is fully powered!
entries.target: #ORCHID#暗影吞噬者的能量已经充满！

entries.source: Touching this cloak of otherworldly fabric makes you feel both drowsy yet completely aware.
entries.target: 这件披风由异界的织物制成，触摸它时你会既昏昏欲睡又十分清醒。

entries.source: This jagged shape looks like a hole in space, yet it is solid, though light in weight.
entries.target: 这个锯齿状的物体看上去像是空间中的一个洞，但它却是实心的，只是重量很轻。

entries.source: thick coral plate
entries.target: 厚重的珊瑚板

entries.source: A chunk of jagged coral, dredged from the ocean.
entries.target: 一块参差不齐的珊瑚，从海中打捞而来。

entries.source: familiar pouch
entries.target: 熟悉的弹药袋

entries.source: These perfectly white spheres appear to have been worn down by years of exposure to strong winds.
entries.target: 这些纯白的弹丸似乎经受了多年强风的磨蚀。

entries.source: This sword appears weightless, and nearly invisible.
entries.target: 这把剑似乎没有重量，几乎看不见。

entries.source: %s pulls %s %s around %s like a dark shroud!
entries.target: %s将%s%s裹在%s身上，宛如一层黑暗的帷幕！

entries.source: Malslek the Accursed's Hat
entries.target: 被诅咒者马斯拉克之帽

entries.source: This black hat once belonged to a powerful mage named Malslek, in the Age of Dusk, who was known to deal with beings from other planes. In particular, he dealt with many powerful demons, until one of them, tired of his affairs, betrayed him and stole his power. In his rage, Malslek set fire to his own tower in an attempt to kill the demon. This charred hat is all that remained in the ruins.
entries.target: 这顶黑色的帽子曾属于黄昏纪一名强大的法师马斯拉克，他以与异界生物打交道而著称。尤其是，他与许多强大的恶魔做过交易。直到某一天，一名恶魔厌倦了与他的纠葛，背叛了他并偷走了他的力量。马斯拉克一气之下烧毁了自己的高塔，意图杀死这只恶魔。废墟中只剩下了这顶烧焦的帽子。

entries.source: This leather cap is overgrown with a thick moss, except for around the very front, where an eye, carved of wood, rests. A thick green slime slowly pours from the corners of the eye, like tears.
entries.target: 这顶皮帽上长满了厚厚的苔藓，唯独正前方没有，那里嵌着一只木雕的眼睛。浓稠的绿色黏液从眼角缓缓流出，仿佛眼泪一样。

entries.source: This thick robe is woven from a dark green moss, firmly bound and cool to the touch. It is said to have rejuvenating properties.
entries.target: 这件厚厚的长袍是用深绿色的苔藓织成的，十分牢固，摸上去很清凉。据说，它有恢复活力的功效。

entries.source: entwined iron ring
entries.target: 交缠的铁戒指

entries.source: This ornate blade is carved from the wood of a tree said to burn eternally. Its hilt is encrusted with gems, suggesting it once belonged to a figure of considerable status. The flames seem to bend to the will of the sword's holder.
entries.target: 这把华丽的剑由传说中永恒燃烧之树的木材雕刻而成。剑柄镶嵌着宝石，暗示它曾属于一位地位显赫的人物。剑身的火焰似乎会听从持剑者的意志。

entries.source:
This rugged jacket is the subject of many a rural legend.
Some say it was fashioned by an adventurous mage turned rogue, in times before the Spellblaze, but was since lost.
All manner of shady gamblers have since claimed to have worn it at one point or another. To fail, but live, is what it means to be untouchable, they said.
entries.target:
这件结实的夹克是许多乡村传说的主角。
有人说，在魔法大爆炸之前的年代，一位转行盗贼的冒险法师制作了它，但此后便遗失了。
形形色色来路不正的赌徒都声称自己曾穿过它。他们说，失败却活下来，这就是“不可触及”的含义。

entries.source: sap filled cup
entries.target: 盛满树液的杯子

entries.source: This is a string of ancient, hardened clay beads, cracked and faded with age. It was used by Wilders in ancient times, in an attempt to enhance their connection with Nature.
entries.target: 这是一串古朴而坚硬的陶制串珠，年代久远，已经开裂褪色。远古时代，荒野行者曾佩戴它来加强与自然的联系。

entries.source: gloomy black cloak
entries.target: 阴郁的黑色斗篷

entries.source: This impossibly cold chain of frost-coated metal radiates a strange and imposing aura.
entries.target: 这条覆着冰霜的金属链冷得不可思议，散发出诡异而威严的光环。

entries.source: This warped, blackened sword drips acid from its countless pores.
entries.target: 这柄扭曲发黑的剑从无数细孔中滴落酸液。

entries.source: Enter Rampage if health falls below 20%%%s
entries.target: 当生命值低于20%%时，进入暴走%s。

entries.source: This ordinary blade is made of fine, sturdy voratun and outfitted with jagged hooks along the edge. This simple appearance belies a great power - the hooked maw of this dagger broke many a blade and the stride of many would-be warriors.
entries.target: 这柄普通的匕首是由精制坚硬的沃瑞钽制成的，配有锯齿钩边。看似平凡的外表背后潜藏着强大的力量——它那带钩的利齿折断过无数刀刃，也让许多自诩战士之人止步。

entries.source:
Stolen flesh,
	Stolen pain,
	To give it up,
	Is to live again.
entries.target:
窃取血肉，
	窃取苦痛，
	将其舍弃，
	便得重生。

entries.source: With a better grip it would be the destroyer of your enemies.
entries.target: 若能握得更牢，它将成为敌人的毁灭者。

entries.source: This massive hammer strikes with deadly force. Bones crunch, splinter and grind to dust under its impact.
entries.target: 这柄巨锤挥击时带着致命的力量。在它的冲击下，骨头嘎吱作响、碎裂迸散，最终被碾成齑粉。

entries.source: Yaldan Baoth
entries.target: 雅尔丹·巴奥斯

entries.source: obscuring helm
entries.target: 遮蔽视线的头盔

entries.source: This massive suit of plate boasts an enormous bulk and overbearing weight. Said to belong to a nameless soldier who safeguarded a passage across the bridge to his village, in defiance to the cohorts of invading orcs. After days of assault failed to fell him, the orcs turned back. The man however, fell dead on the spot - from exhaustion. The armor had finally claimed his life.
entries.target: 这件巨大的板甲体积庞大，重得压人。相传它属于一位无名士兵，他守在通往自己村庄的桥上，抵御入侵的兽人大军。兽人连攻数日也未能将他击倒，只得撤退。然而这名士兵却当场倒地身亡——死于力竭。这件盔甲终究夺去了他的生命。

entries.source: flame coated sandals
entries.target: 一双被火焰覆盖的凉鞋

entries.source:
Your mind is attuned to electricity.
Any lightning damage you do that is more than 10% of the victim's maximum life will attempt to brainlock the target.
Upon taking lightning damage >10% of your max life, your mind fires back, dealing 30% of the original damage as mind and trying to brainlock the target.
Upon taking mind damage >10% of your max life, you reflexively trigger the jolt, sending an arc of dazing lightning toward the target (damage based on mindpower).
This item can have up to 2 charges, with each charge having 4 turn cooldown.
entries.target:
你的精神与电力连接。
当你造成的闪电伤害超过目标最大生命值10%时，会试图对其附加思维封锁效果。
当你受到超过最大生命值10%的闪电伤害时，你的精神会发起反击，造成原伤害30%的精神伤害，并试图附加思维封锁效果。
当你受到超过最大生命值10%的精神伤害时，你会反射性地触发震击，朝目标射出一道致眩闪电（伤害基于精神强度）。
这个物品可以存储两次充能，每次充能冷却时间4回合。

entries.source: Crafted for a warlord who wanted to keep his subjects under a stralite grip. Dark thoughts went into the making of these gauntlets, literally.
entries.target: 这副手套为一位军阀打造，他想用斯莱特般的铁腕统治自己的臣民。打造它时，真的注入了黑暗的思想。

entries.source: Bind the brilliant powers into glyphs to trap your foes.
entries.target: 将璀璨之力束入圣印，困住敌人。

entries.source: Sing of death and damnation.
entries.target: 吟唱死亡与天谴。

entries.source:
Infuse your weapon with the power of the Sun, adding %0.1f light damage on each melee hit.
		Additionally, if you have a temporary damage shield active, melee hits will increase its power by %d and set its duration to 2 (if not already higher), once per turn.
		The damage dealt and shield bonus will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
使你的武器充满太阳能量，每次近战命中造成 %0.1f 光系伤害。
		如果你同时打开了临时伤害护盾，每回合一次，你的近战攻击命中可以增加护盾 %d 强度，并且可以延长当前护盾持续时间至2回合。
		伤害和护盾加成受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
Your dirges carry the pain within you, which threatens to swallow those who come too close.  Anyone who hits you in melee suffers %0.2f mind damage.
							You, on the other hand, are steadied by the song.  Your dirges increase your resistance to stun and knockback by %d%%.
							The damage will increase with your Mindpower and your level.
entries.target:
你的挽歌中寄寓着痛苦，过于接近你的生物可能会被这份痛苦吞噬。任何近战击中你的生物会受到 %0.2f 精神伤害。
							而你则被这歌声激励着。挽歌增加你 %d%% 的震慑和击退抗性。
							伤害受精神强度和等级加成。

entries.source: Blood Red Moon
entries.target: 血红之月

entries.source:
Your glyphs are imbued with celestial fury; they last %d turns longer and when triggered they will deal damage.
		#ffd700#Glyph of Sunlight#LAST#:  Deals %0.2f light damage.
		#7f7f7f#Glyph of Moonlight#LAST#:  Deals %0.2f darkness damage.
		#9D9DC9#Glyph of Twilight#LAST#:  Deals %0.2f light and %0.2f darkness damage.
entries.target:
你的圣印被注入了来自天空的怒火，持续时间延长 %d 回合，并在触发时造成伤害。
		#ffd700#日光圣印#LAST#：造成 %0.2f 光系伤害。
		#7f7f7f#月光圣印#LAST#：造成 %0.2f 暗影伤害。
		#9D9DC9#暮光圣印#LAST#：造成 %0.2f 光系和 %0.2f 暗影伤害。
